verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no pricing or billing documentation, so nothing states that sandboxes are billed per second or only for compute actually used. Scale-to-zero after 5s of inactivity (blaxel-docs-2, blaxel-docs-16) and expiration policies for storage costs are adjacent behaviors. They imply lower idle cost but do not document per-second compute billing.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can pay per second only for the compute a sandbox actually uses
